schema.title: Font Size
schema.description: Controls the font size in pixels for the code viewer.

schema.title: Font Family
schema.description: Controls the font family used in the code viewer.

schema.title: Line Height
schema.description: Controls the line height in pixels for the code viewer.

schema.title: Tab Size
schema.description: The number of spaces a tab is equal to.

schema.title: Word Wrap
schema.description: Controls whether lines should wrap around or scroll horizontally.

schema.title: Line Numbers
schema.description: Controls the display of line numbers in the gutter.

schema.title: Vim Keybindings
schema.description: Enable Vim modal navigation (Normal mode, Visual mode, motions, search, and LSP shortcuts).

schema.title: Render Whitespace
schema.description: Controls how whitespace characters are rendered in the viewer.

schema.title: Minimap Hits
schema.description: Controls whether search hit indicators are shown in the scroll minimap gutter.

schema.title: Color Theme
schema.description: Specifies the color theme used in the workbench.

schema.title: Diff Side By Side
schema.description: Controls whether the diff editor shows changes in split (side-by-side) or unified mode.

schema.title: Markdown Preview
schema.description: Controls whether Markdown files open in rendered preview by default.

schema.title: Table View
schema.description: Controls whether CSV and TSV files open as a table by default.

schema.title: Cursor Style
schema.description: Controls the cursor style in the code viewer.

schema.title: Cursor Blinking
schema.description: Controls the cursor animation style.

schema.title: Render Line Highlight
schema.description: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight.

schema.title: Occurrences Highlight
schema.description: Controls whether the editor should highlight occurrences of the selected word.

schema.title: Scroll Beyond Last Line
schema.description: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line of the file.

schema.title: Bracket Pair Colorization
schema.description: Controls whether bracket pair colorization and matching is enabled.

schema.title: Compact Folders
schema.description: Controls whether the file tree renders single-child directory chains compactly.

schema.title: Auto Reveal
schema.description: Controls whether the file explorer automatically scrolls to and reveals active tabs.

schema.title: Files Exclude Patterns
schema.description: Configure glob patterns for excluding files and folders from search and trees.

schema.title: Smart Case Search
schema.description: Searches case-insensitively when query is lowercase, and case-sensitively when uppercase characters exist.

schema.title: Max Search Results
schema.description: Controls the maximum number of results returned in workspace-wide searches.

schema.title: Diff: Ignore Trim Whitespace
schema.description: Controls whether the diff viewer ignores changes in leading or trailing whitespace.

schema.title: Git Gutter Indicators
schema.description: Controls whether changed line indicators are shown in the editor gutter.

schema.title: Language Server Protocol (LSP)
schema.description: Master switch for language server integrations (definitions, references, diagnostics).

schema.title: Hover Documentation
schema.description: Controls whether hovercards with documentation and type signatures appear on hover.

schema.title: Coding Harness
schema.description: Coding agent harness invoked for code edits (e.g. claude, codex, agy, opencode, cursor-agent).

schema.title: Agent Timeout (Seconds)
schema.description: Controls the maximum execution time in seconds for agent edits before canceling.

schema.title: Auto Accept Agent Edits
schema.description: Controls whether agent-generated code diffs are accepted without manual confirmation.

schema.title: Commit Message Instructions
schema.description: Extra instructions given to the coding harness when it writes a commit message for the staged diff (e.g. "Follow Conventional Commits" or "Reference the ticket number in the branch name").

schema.title: GitHub Token
schema.description: Personal access token used to check out and review pull requests (faah <url>). Takes precedence over the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable and 'gh auth token'.

schema.title: GitLab Token
schema.description: Personal access token (api scope) used to check out, review and merge GitLab merge requests, on gitlab.com or a self-hosted instance. Sent only to the GitLab Host below; other self-hosted instances use the token 'glab auth login' stored for them. Takes precedence over the GITLAB_TOKEN environment variable.

schema.title: GitLab Host
schema.description: The GitLab instance the GitLab token belongs to (e.g. gitlab.example.com). Merge requests on any other host are opened without it. Falls back to GITLAB_HOST, then gitlab.com.

schema.title: Gitea Token
schema.description: Access token (repository and issue read/write scopes) for Gitea, Forgejo or Codeberg pull request review. Sent only to the Gitea Host below. Takes precedence over the GITEA_TOKEN environment variable.

schema.title: Gitea Host
schema.description: The Gitea or Forgejo instance the Gitea token belongs to (e.g. gitea.example.com). Pull requests on any other host are opened without it. Falls back to GITEA_HOST, then codeberg.org.

schema.title: Bitbucket Token
schema.description: Bitbucket Cloud token for pull request review: a repository, project or workspace access token, or an Atlassian API token (then also set Bitbucket Email). Takes precedence over the BITBUCKET_TOKEN environment variable.

schema.title: Bitbucket Email
schema.description: The Atlassian account email an API token belongs to. Leave empty when Bitbucket Token is an access token. Falls back to BITBUCKET_EMAIL. Checking push access (and so Approve and Merge) needs an API token.

schema.title: Base Path
schema.description: Base URL path prefix for the faah server and web interface (e.g. /rev-123/).

schema.title: Explain Agent
schema.description: The coding harness that writes explanations (claude, codex, agy, opencode or cursor-agent). Leave empty to use the harness selected for editing. Ignored when faah is started with -agent.

schema.title: Explain Model
schema.description: The model explanations run on, as the explain agent names it. A smaller model answers faster. Leave empty to use that harness's own model.

schema.title: Prepare Explanations on Selection
schema.description: Gathers definitions, callers and references in the background when you select code, so Explain starts sooner.

schema.title: About You
schema.description: Added to the explain agent's prompt to describe the reader, for example "I'm new to Go".
